pāṇaṃ na haññe na c'adinnam'ādiye, musā na bhāse na ca majjapo siyā, abrahmacariyā virameyya methunā, rattiṃ na bhuñjeyya vikālabhojanaṃ.

7456.meaning1: not the spiritual path; wrong spiritual practice; unholy life
7456.meaning2: what is not the life divine, not the holy life

examples.text: āyasmā ānando etadavoca, cattāro'me, sandaka, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena abrahmacariyavāsā akkhātā cattāri ca anassāsikāni brahmacariyāni akkhātāni, yattha viññū puriso sasakkaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na vaseyya, vasanto ca n'ārādheyya ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalan'ti.

7457.grammar: adj, comp, from na brahmacariya, neg
7457.meaning1: not living the holy life; not following the spiritual path; not a celibate renunciant
7457.construction:
na > a + brahma + cariya + vant
abrahmacariya + vant

examples.text: yāvatā, bho, rañño pasenadissa kosalassa vijitaṃ yattha ca rājā pasenadi kosalo issariy'ādhipaccaṃ rajjaṃ kāreti, pahoti tattha rājā pasenadi kosalo samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā puññavantaṃ vā apuññavantaṃ vā brahmacariyavantaṃ vā abrahmacariyavantaṃ vā tamhā ṭhānā cāvetuṃ vā pabbājetuṃ vā'ti.

7458.meaning1: way of not living the spiritual life; negation of the holy life

examples.text: āyasmā ānando etadavoca, cattāro'me, sandaka, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena abrahmacariyavāsā akkhātā cattāri ca anassāsikāni brahmacariyāni akkhātāni, yattha viññū puriso sasakkaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na vaseyya, vasanto ca n'ārādheyya ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalan'ti.

7459.meaning1: not celibate; not leading the holy life; sexually active
7459.commentary: (MNa) abrahmaṃ hīnaṃ lāmakadhammaṃ carantī'ti abrahmacārī, methunadhammappaṭisevakā'ti attho.

examples.text: pare abrahmacārī bhavissanti, mayam'ettha brahmacārī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

addasā kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno taṃ puggalaṃ dussīlaṃ pāpadhammaṃ asuciṃ saṅkassarasamācāraṃ paṭicchannakamm'antaṃ asamaṇaṃ samaṇapaṭiññaṃ abrahmacāriṃ brahmacāripaṭiññaṃ antopūtiṃ avassutaṃ kasambujātaṃ majjhe bhikkhusaṅghassa nisinnaṃ

7460.meaning1: not respecting Brahmans; (comm) not respecting arahants
7460.construction:
na > a + √brah > brāh + ma + *aṇa + ya
abrāhmaṇa + ya
7460.commentary: (ANa) abrahmañño'ti ettha ca khīṇ'āsavā brāhmaṇā nāma, tesu micchā paṭipanno abrahmañño nāma.

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye brahmaññā, atha kho et'eva bahutarā sattā ye abrahmaññā
tam'enaṃ, bhikkhave, nirayapālā nānābāhāsu gahetvā yamassa rañño dassenti, ayaṃ, deva, puriso amatteyyo apetteyyo asāmañño abrahmañño, na kule jeṭṭh'āpacāyī. imassa devo daṇḍaṃ paṇetū'ti.

7461.grammar: fem, abstr, from na brahmañña, neg
7461.construction:
na > a + √brah + ma + na + ya + tā
abrahmañña + tā

examples.text: aḍḍhateyyavassasat'āyukesu, bhikkhave, manussesu ime dhammā vepullam'agamaṃsu. amatteyyatā apetteyyatā asāmaññatā abrahmaññatā na kule jeṭṭh'āpacāyitā.

7462.meaning1: not honouring Brahmans; not respecting holy men
7462.construction:
na > a + √brah + ma + na + ya
abrāhmaṇa + ya

examples.text: tam'enaṃ, bhikkhave, nirayapālā nānābāhāsu gahetvā yamassa rañño dassenti, ayaṃ, deva, puriso amatteyyo apetteyyo asāmañño abrāhmañño, na kule jeṭṭh'āpacāyī. imassa devo daṇḍaṃ paṇetū'ti.

7463.meaning1: not a Brahman; not a holy man
7463.construction:
na > a + √brah > brāh + ma + *aṇa
na + brahma + *aṇa

examples.text: mayañ'hi pubbe assamaṇā'va samānā samaṇ'amhā'ti paṭijānimha, abrāhmaṇā'va samānā brāhmaṇ'amhā'ti paṭijānimha, anarahanto'va samānā arahant'amhā'ti paṭijānimha.

7464.meaning1: not a man of the Brahman caste
7464.construction:
na > a + √brah > brāh + ma + *aṇa
na + brahma + *aṇa

examples.text: brāhmaṇā, bho kaccāna, evam'āhaṃsu, brāhmaṇo'va seṭṭho vaṇṇo, hīno añño vaṇṇo, brāhmaṇo'va sukko vaṇṇo, kaṇho añño vaṇṇo, brāhmaṇā'va sujjhanti, no abrāhmaṇā, brāhmaṇā'va brahmuno puttā orasā mukhato jātā brahmajā brahmanimmitā brahmadāy'ādā'ti.
nassa padassa tappurise uttarapade attaṃ hoti. nabrāhmaṇo abrāhmaṇo, avasalo, abhikkhu, apañcavassaṃ, apañcagavaṃ.

7465.meaning1: which does not make one a Brahman; which Brahmans don't do
7465.meaning2: which does not make one a Brahman
7465.commentary: (DNa) ye dhammā brāhmaṇakārakā'ti ettha pañcasīla-dasakusalakammapatha-bhedā dhammā brāhmaṇakārakā'ti veditabbā, tabbiparītā abrāhmaṇakārakā.

examples.text: ye dhammā abrāhmaṇakārakā te dhamme samādāya vattamānā evam'āhaṃsu, indam'avhayāma, somam'avhayāma, varuṇam'avhayāma, īsānam'avhayāma, pajāpatim'avhayāma, brahmam'avhayāma, mahiddhim'avhayāma, yamam'avhayāmā'ti.

7466.construction:
na > a + √brah > brāh + ma + *ṇa + ī
abrāhmaṇa + ī

examples.text: jānanti pana bhonto yo janako pitā brāhmaṇiṃ'y'eva agamāsi, no abrāhmaṇin'ti? no h'idaṃ, bho.

7467.grammar: prp of na bhajati, neg, trans (+acc)

examples.text: tassa asevitabbe dhamme sevato sevitabbe dhamme asevato, abhajitabbe dhamme bhajato bhajitabbe dhamme abhajato aniṭṭhā akantā amanāpā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, iṭṭhā kantā manāpā dhammā parihāyanti.

7468.meaning1: should not be kept company with; should not be associated with; should not be adhered to; (comm) should not be stuck to

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, assutavā puthujjano… sevitabbe dhamme na jānāti asevitabbe dhamme na jānāti, bhajitabbe dhamme na jānāti abhajitabbe dhamme na jānāti.
evaṃ, bhante'ti kho āyasmā soṇo bhagavato paṭissutvā soḷasa aṭṭhakavaggikāni sabbān'eva sarena abhaṇi.

7470.grammar: nt, act, from na bhaṇḍati, neg

examples.text: bhāsitā kho sakkena devānam'indena gāthāyo. tā ca kho adaṇḍ'āvacarā asatth'āvacarā, iti abhaṇḍanaṃ iti aviggaho iti akalaho. sakkassa devānam'indassa subhāsitena jayo'ti.

7471.grammar: prp of na bhaṇḍati, neg, trans (+acc)
7471.meaning1: not abusing; not accusing; not conflicting

examples.text: sace te, bho gotama, nappaṭiggaṇhanti, amhākam'eva taṃ hotī'ti. evam'eva kho, brāhmaṇa, yaṃ tvaṃ amhe anakkosante akkosasi, arosente rosesi, abhaṇḍante bhaṇḍasi, taṃ te mayaṃ nappaṭiggaṇhāma. tav'ev'etaṃ, brāhmaṇa, hoti, tav'ev'etaṃ, brāhmaṇa, hoti.

7472.construction:
na > a + √bhad + ra + ka
abhadra + ka
7472.synonym: akalla, ananucchavika, appaṭirūpa, appatirūpa, asāruppa, nappatirūpa

7473.grammar: ptp of na bhavati, neg (+dat or +inf)
7473.commentary: (ITIa) abhabbo dukkhakkhayāyā'ti nibbānāya sakalassa vaṭṭadukkhassa khepanāya na bhabbo, n'ālaṃ na samattho'ti attho.

examples.text: appamādarato bhikkhu, pamāde bhayadassi vā, abhabbo parihānāya, nibbānass'eva santike.
seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, paṇḍupalāso bandhanā pavutto abhabbo haritattāya, evam'eva kho, sunakkhatta, āneñj'ādhimuttassa purisapuggalassa ye lok'āmisasaṃyojane se pavutte.

7474.meaning1: ineffective; inoperative; incapable of producing a result

examples.text: iti kho, ānanda, atthi kammaṃ abhabbaṃ abhabb'ābhāsaṃ, atthi kammaṃ abhabbaṃ bhabb'ābhāsaṃ, atthi kammaṃ bhabbañ'c'eva bhabb'ābhāsañ'ca, atthi kammaṃ bhabbaṃ abhabb'ābhāsan'ti.

7475.meaning1: impossibility; that which is not possible

examples.text: pañca abhabbaṭṭhānāni. abhabbo, āvuso, khīṇ'āsavo bhikkhu sañcicca pāṇaṃ jīvitā voropetuṃ.

7476.grammar: fem, abstr, from na bhabba, neg (+dat)
7476.construction:
na > a + √bhū > bhav + *ya + tā
abhabba + tā

examples.text: kiñ'c'āpi so kamma karoti pāpakaṃ, kāyena vācā uda cetasā vā, abhabba so tassa paṭicchadāya, abhabbatā diṭṭhapadassa vuttā, idam'pi saṅghe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.
na hi m'ettha, bhikkhave, abhabbatā vuttā.

7480.commentary: (MNa) abhabb'ābhāsan'ti abhabbaṃ ābhāsati abhibhavati paṭibāhatī'ti attho. bahukasmiñ'hi akusalakamme āyūhite balavakammaṃ dubbalakammassa vipākaṃ paṭibāhitvā attano vipākassa okāsaṃ karoti idaṃ abhabbañ'c'eva abhabb'ābhāsañ'ca. kusalaṃ pana āyūhitvā āsanne akusalaṃ kataṃ hoti, taṃ kusalassa vipākaṃ paṭibāhitvā attano vipākassa okāsaṃ karoti, idaṃ abhabbaṃ bhabb'ābhāsaṃ. bahumhi kusale āyūhite'pi balavakammaṃ dubbalakammassa vipākaṃ paṭibāhitvā attano vipākassa okāsaṃ karoti, idaṃ bhabbañ'c'eva bhabb'ābhāsañ'ca.

examples.text: iti kho, ānanda, atthi kammaṃ abhabbaṃ abhabb'ābhāsaṃ, atthi kammaṃ abhabbaṃ bhabb'ābhāsaṃ, atthi kammaṃ bhabbañ'c'eva bhabb'ābhāsañ'ca, atthi kammaṃ bhabbaṃ abhabb'ābhāsan'ti.

7481.meaning1: safe; without fear; free from fright

examples.text: na tena paṇḍito hoti, yāvatā bahu bhāsati, khemī averī abhayo, paṇḍito'ti pavuccati.
yena yena subhikkhāni, sivāni abhayāni ca, tena puttaka gacchassu, mā sokāpahato bhavā'ti.
abhaye bhayadassino, bhaye c'ābhayadassino, micchādiṭṭhisamādānā, sattā gacchanti duggatiṃ.
yena yena subhikkhāni, sivāni abhayāni ca, tena puttaka gacchassu, mā sokāpahato bhavā'ti.

ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭ'āgārasālāyaṃ. atha kho sāḷho ca licchavi abhayo ca licchavi yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdiṃsu.

7484.meaning1: name of a prince; king Bimbisāra's son

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe. atha kho abhayo rājakumāro yena nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā nigaṇṭhaṃ nāṭaputtaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.

7487.meaning1: guarantee of safety; pledge of safe passage

examples.text: siyā'pi no asurato bhayaṃ. yaṃnūna mayaṃ sambaraṃ asur'indaṃ upasaṅkamitvā abhayadakkhiṇaṃ yāceyyāmā'ti.

7488.meaning1: not knowing the danger; not wary; not fearful; not apprehensive (of)

examples.text: abhaye bhayadassino, bhaye ca-abhayadassino, micchādiṭṭhisamādānā, sattā gacchanti duggatiṃ.
etam'ahaṃ, sāriputta, nimittaṃ asamanupassanto khemappatto abhayappatto vesārajjappatto viharāmi.

7498.commentary: (MNa) abhay'ūparato'ti abhayo hutvā uparato, accant'ūparato satat'ūparatoti attho. na vā bhayena uparato'ti'pi abhay'ūparato.

examples.text: abhay'ūparato ayam'āyasmā, n'āyam'āyasmā bhay'ūparato, vītarāgattā kāme na sevati khayā rāgassā'ti?
tassa sokaparetassa, vīṇā kacchā abhassatha, tato so dummano yakkho, tatth'ev'antaradhāyathā'ti.
